answer_parts.text: CCTV footage is retained for 31 days as the standard retention period, and it is then automatically deleted unless it is specifically retained longer because it relates to an ongoing incident, safeguarding concern, or legal matter, in which case it is kept only for as long as genuinely relevant to that specific matter.

Only the registered manager or their deputy are authorised to view footage, and they may do so only for a specific, recorded purpose (for example to investigate a reported incident); any request from police or another external body is referred to the Data Protection Lead, who confirms the requester’s legal basis before disclosure.
